items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: As far as bands were concerned, we heard lots of them, like the Happy Six, Paul Specht.

ctx.x: For those who may listen to this tape, my name is John Steiner. I want to introduce Edwin Ashcraft, Squirrel Ashcraft, who's been a leader in Chicago of the Chicago-style jazz bands, both amateur and professional. And his name will be familiar to anyone in our generation who has been acquainted with the Chicago Fellows. Squirrel has played and recorded with people like Freeman and McPartland. He knew Teschmacher and knew well that Davy Tuff and Krupa has played on many occasions with the Condon gang and is…

Well, I was born in 1905, which was approximately when most of the Austin High School band were born. I might add that I was probably born in just about the right place at about the right time for some unusual chances to observe, and I wish I'd observed a little better. Or at least I wish I'd recorded it a little better. I'm a third-generation lawyer. My family came here from Virginia and from Massachusetts and came up from Vandalia, Illinois. I have two sisters. I've been a lawyer ever since, a member of a…
Maybe a little later, before he arrived in Chicago.
